corrections.text: The article quotes OpenMandriva's audit as finding "no other violations" and cites Linuxiac for this. Linuxiac's article actually paraphrases this as "found no other problems aside from the removed packages" rather than using this exact wording. The verbatim phrase "no other violations" comes from OpenMandriva's original forum statement, not from Linuxiac's article. The underlying fact is accurate and independently confirmed.

The article presents "triggered by a few members of the project who did not agree with OpenMandriva's focus on KDE and LXQt" as Davide Beatrici's direct quote ("He said the underlying conflict was..."). In the cited BleepingComputer article, this sentence is the reporter's paraphrase of Beatrici's account ("As Beatrici says, this action was triggered by..."), not a direct quotation of Beatrici's own words. The substance is accurately sourced to BleepingComputer, but it should have been presented as reported speech rather than a direct quote.
